comment: Outside web addresses that appear as text in the files of the release, and why none is ever requested. Found by scanning the real build (specs/004 research R8, 2026-10-31). verify-release fails on any host not listed here, so a new one has to be looked at and added with its reason. Binary files are not scanned; the offline end-to-end test, which refuses every request that is not to the launcher, is the proof that nothing is requested.
